title: Montenegro Closes Two More Chapters on Its Path to the EU

sources.name: Council of the European Union
sources.title: Enlargement: EU and Montenegro close accession negotiations on free movement of goods and food safety

paragraphs.en: On November 6, 2026, the European Union and Montenegro
paragraphs.zh: 2026年11月6日，歐盟與蒙特內哥羅

paragraphs.en: announced progress in talks about EU membership.
paragraphs.zh: 宣布加入歐盟的談判取得進展。

paragraphs.en: They provisionally closed two more negotiating chapters,
paragraphs.zh: 雙方再度暫時完成兩個談判章節，

paragraphs.en: bringing the total to 23 out of 33.
paragraphs.zh: 使暫時完成的章節達到33個中的23個。

paragraphs.en: The latest chapters cover the free movement of goods
paragraphs.zh: 最新完成的章節涵蓋商品自由流通

paragraphs.en: and food safety, including animal and plant health rules.
paragraphs.zh: 及食品安全，其中包括動植物衛生規範。

paragraphs.en: The word "provisionally" matters.
paragraphs.zh: 「暫時」這個詞很重要。

paragraphs.en: It means that this progress remains conditional.
paragraphs.zh: 它代表這項進展仍附帶條件。

paragraphs.en: The EU can return to these chapters if necessary,
paragraphs.zh: 歐盟必要時可以重新討論這些章節，

paragraphs.en: and individual agreements are not final
paragraphs.zh: 而且個別協議並不算最終定案，

paragraphs.en: until an overall agreement covers all chapters.
paragraphs.zh: 必須等到所有章節達成整體協議才算完成。

paragraphs.en: Monitoring will continue during the negotiations.
paragraphs.zh: 在談判期間，監督工作仍會持續。

paragraphs.en: The announcement therefore marks another stage
paragraphs.zh: 因此，這項公告標誌著又一個階段，

paragraphs.en: in a continuing process.
paragraphs.zh: 而整個程序仍在進行。

paragraphs.en: For example, a closed chapter can still be checked
paragraphs.zh: 舉例來說，即使章節已暫時完成，仍可檢查

paragraphs.en: against the country's continuing implementation
paragraphs.zh: 該國是否持續落實

paragraphs.en: of the relevant EU rules.
paragraphs.zh: 相關的歐盟規範。

paragraphs.en: Montenegro's path towards membership has been long.
paragraphs.zh: 蒙特內哥羅走向入盟的道路已歷時多年。

paragraphs.en: According to the Council's country information,
paragraphs.zh: 根據歐盟理事會的國家資訊，

paragraphs.en: it applied in December 2008,
paragraphs.zh: 該國於2008年12月提出申請，

paragraphs.en: received candidate status in December 2010,
paragraphs.zh: 於2010年12月取得候選國地位，

paragraphs.en: and began accession negotiations in June 2012.
paragraphs.zh: 並於2012年6月開始入盟談判。

paragraphs.en: The talks divide EU rules into policy chapters.
paragraphs.zh: 談判將歐盟規範分成不同政策章節。

paragraphs.en: This structure allows officials to examine
paragraphs.zh: 這種架構讓官員能夠檢視

paragraphs.en: different responsibilities in a more organised way.
paragraphs.zh: 不同的責任，並以更有條理的方式進行。

paragraphs.en: Negotiations take place at conferences
paragraphs.zh: 談判在會議中進行，

paragraphs.en: involving EU representatives and the candidate,
paragraphs.zh: 由歐盟代表與候選國參與，

paragraphs.en: bringing different areas of responsibility into a common framework.
paragraphs.zh: 將不同責任領域納入共同架構。

paragraphs.en: Joining the EU requires more than technical agreements.
paragraphs.zh: 加入歐盟需要的不只是技術性協議。

paragraphs.en: Candidates must meet political and economic conditions.
paragraphs.zh: 候選國必須符合政治與經濟條件。

paragraphs.en: These include stable democratic institutions, respect for human rights,
paragraphs.zh: 其中包括穩定的民主制度、尊重人權，

paragraphs.en: and the rule of law.
paragraphs.zh: 以及法治。

paragraphs.en: A functioning market economy is also required,
paragraphs.zh: 此外，也必須具備能正常運作的市場經濟，

paragraphs.en: along with the ability to handle competition.
paragraphs.zh: 以及應對競爭的能力。

paragraphs.en: Public institutions must be able
paragraphs.zh: 公共機構必須有能力

paragraphs.en: to apply the shared rules
paragraphs.zh: 落實共同規範，

paragraphs.en: and accept membership obligations.
paragraphs.zh: 並承擔會員國義務。

paragraphs.en: Even after all policy chapters were settled,
paragraphs.zh: 即使所有政策章節都已談妥，

paragraphs.en: several formal steps would remain.
paragraphs.zh: 仍有幾個正式步驟需要完成。

paragraphs.en: An accession treaty would need
paragraphs.zh: 入盟條約需要獲得

paragraphs.en: the European Parliament's consent
paragraphs.zh: 歐洲議會的同意，

paragraphs.en: and unanimous approval from the Council.
paragraphs.zh: 以及歐盟理事會的一致批准。

paragraphs.en: All EU member states and the candidate country
paragraphs.zh: 所有歐盟會員國與候選國

paragraphs.en: would then sign it.
paragraphs.zh: 接著才會簽署條約。

paragraphs.en: Each party must ratify the treaty
paragraphs.zh: 各方必須批准該條約，

paragraphs.en: under its own constitutional rules.
paragraphs.zh: 並依照各自的憲政規定辦理。

paragraphs.en: Membership begins on the date specified in that treaty.
paragraphs.zh: 會員國身分會於條約所定的日期生效。

paragraphs.en: Preparation is also necessary on the EU side.
paragraphs.zh: 歐盟方面也需要做好準備。

paragraphs.en: Its enlargement guidance explains that the Union
paragraphs.zh: 歐盟的擴大政策說明指出，歐盟本身

paragraphs.en: must be able to take in new members.
paragraphs.zh: 必須有能力接納新會員國。

paragraphs.en: In October 2026, EU leaders stressed
paragraphs.zh: 2026年10月，歐盟領袖強調，

paragraphs.en: that both future members and the EU must be ready.
paragraphs.zh: 未來會員國與歐盟都必須準備就緒。

paragraphs.en: The discussion therefore includes the Union's own policies,
paragraphs.zh: 因此，討論也包括歐盟本身的政策、

paragraphs.en: priorities and ability to act.
paragraphs.zh: 優先事項與行動能力。

paragraphs.en: For readers following this international development,
paragraphs.zh: 對持續關注這項國際動態的讀者而言，

paragraphs.en: the chapter count provides one useful measure of progress.
paragraphs.zh: 章節完成數量是衡量進度的一項實用指標。

paragraphs.en: However, the conditions attached to each stage
paragraphs.zh: 不過，每個階段附帶的條件

paragraphs.en: are equally important.
paragraphs.zh: 也同樣重要。

paragraphs.en: The November announcement records a concrete achievement,
paragraphs.zh: 11月這項公告記錄了一項具體成果，

paragraphs.en: while the remaining negotiations and approval procedures
paragraphs.zh: 而後續談判與批准程序，

paragraphs.en: explain why the journey continues.
paragraphs.zh: 則說明了入盟之路為何仍須繼續。

paragraphs.en: Montenegro's next steps will still depend
paragraphs.zh: 蒙特內哥羅接下來的步驟，仍取決於

paragraphs.en: on meeting the relevant requirements
paragraphs.zh: 能否達到相關要求，

paragraphs.en: and moving through the procedures agreed by all sides.
paragraphs.zh: 並完成各方同意的程序。

able.meaning: 有能力的；be able to指能夠

accession.meaning: 加入、入盟；文中指加入歐盟

against.meaning: 對照；checked against指依某標準核對

an.meaning: 一個、一種；母音發音前的不定冠詞

apply.meaning: 落實、適用；文中指實施共同規範

are.meaning: 是；也可作被動語態的助動詞

at.meaning: 在；表示活動發生的場合

be.meaning: 是；與過去分詞連用可構成被動語態

been.meaning: be 的過去分詞，文中與助動詞連用構成完成式或被動語態

both.meaning: 兩者都；both A and B指A與B兩者

chapter.meaning: 章節；文中指入盟談判的政策章節

chapters.meaning: 章節（複數）；文中指不同政策領域

conditions.meaning: 條件；文中指入盟或協議附帶的要求

council.meaning: 理事會；文中指歐盟理事會

council's.meaning: 理事會的；文中指歐盟理事會的

development.meaning: 發展、動態；文中指國際事件的新進展

enlargement.meaning: 擴大；文中指歐盟接納新會員國的程序

even.meaning: 即使；even after指即使在…之後

for.meaning: 為了、對於；for example指舉例來說

free.meaning: 自由的；free movement指自由流通

from.meaning: 來自；表示批准由誰作出

has.meaning: 與過去分詞連用，構成現在完成式

in.meaning: 在某時間、領域或過程中；take in指接納

institutions.meaning: 機構、制度；文中包含民主制度與公共機構

into.meaning: 分成、納入；divide into指劃分為

is.meaning: 是；也可作被動或進行式的助動詞

it.meaning: 它；文中指蒙特內哥羅、條約或前述用語

its.meaning: 它的；文中指歐盟或參與條約的一方的

journey.meaning: 旅程；文中比喻入盟歷程

long.meaning: 長久的；文中指歷時多年

meet.meaning: 符合、達到；文中指滿足條件

meeting.meaning: 達到、符合；meeting requirements指符合要求

membership.meaning: 會員身分；文中指歐盟會員國資格

more.meaning: 更多的；更；more than指不只是

movement.meaning: 流通；文中指商品跨境流通

moving.meaning: 推進、進行；moving through指逐步完成

of.meaning: …的；表示所屬、性質、內容等關係

on.meaning: 在某日期；在某一方；depend on指取決於

parliament's.meaning: 議會的；European Parliament's指歐洲議會的

quiz.question: What is the main purpose of the article?

choices.text: To explain recent progress in Montenegro’s EU talks and the steps that still matter.
choices.explanation: 正確。文章介紹兩個章節的新進展，並說明條件、審查及後續批准程序。

choices.text: To announce the date on which Montenegro will become an EU member.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。文章沒有宣布蒙特內哥羅的入盟日期，只說明日期須由入盟條約訂定。

choices.text: To compare the economies of every current EU member state.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。文章提到市場經濟是入盟條件，但沒有比較各會員國經濟。

choices.text: To argue that food safety is the only remaining membership requirement.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第四、五段列出政治、經濟與正式批准等其他要求。

quiz.explanation: 文章以11月6日暫時完成兩個談判章節為新聞起點，再交代入盟歷程、條件與後續程序。重點是理解這項進展及其仍附帶的要求。

evidence.quote: They provisionally closed two more negotiating chapters, bringing the total to 23 out of 33.
The November announcement records a concrete achievement, while the remaining negotiations and approval procedures explain why the journey continues.

quiz.question: What can reasonably be inferred about a provisionally closed chapter?

choices.text: It automatically gives the candidate country full membership rights.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第五段說明完整入盟還需要條約、批准與生效等步驟。

choices.text: It no longer requires any monitoring during the remaining talks.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第二段明確指出談判期間仍會持續監督。

choices.text: It represents progress, but its agreement can still be revisited.
choices.explanation: 正確。第二段指出協議仍有條件，必要時可以重新討論。

choices.text: It must be negotiated again immediately after every conference.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。正文只說必要時可重新討論，並未要求每次會議後立刻重談。

quiz.explanation: 暫時完成章節代表已有進展，但尚未取得全體章節的最終整體協議，因此不能視為永久定案或自動入盟。

evidence.quote: The EU can return to these chapters if necessary, and individual agreements are not final until an overall agreement covers all chapters.

quiz.question: Which statement best summarises the preparation required for enlargement?

choices.text: Only the candidate country needs to prepare for a larger EU.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第六段明確指出歐盟本身也需要具備接納新會員國的能力。

choices.text: Both sides must prepare, and completing the talks still leaves formal approval steps.
choices.explanation: 正確。第五段列出談判後的條約批准步驟，第六段指出雙方皆需準備就緒。

choices.text: Signing the treaty allows every party to skip its constitutional requirements.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第五段指出各方必須依自己的憲政規定批准條約。

choices.text: The number of closed chapters replaces the need for democratic institutions.
choices.explanation: 錯誤。第四段列明穩定的民主制度是候選國必須符合的條件。

quiz.explanation: 完整準備涉及候選國及歐盟雙方。談完政策章節後，還須完成條約同意、批准與各方依憲政規定辦理的程序；章節數量並不取代這些要求。

evidence.quote: Even after all policy chapters were settled, several formal steps would remain.
In October 2026, EU leaders stressed that both future members and the EU must be ready.
